referee_caveats_inferred: Do not transfer NOEMA calibration, robust-weighting or spectral-binning settings to ACA; ACA processing is unspecified.
The wording assigning ∼0.7 and 0.86 in the ACA/NOEMA comparison is ambiguous relative to the earlier NOEMA ratios; verify the intended assignments before defining an answer key.
The LTE model prints 2.4 M⊙ yr−1, whereas the introduction quotes 2.4×10−7 M⊙ yr−1 from earlier work; resolve this discrepancy before implementing the model.
The velocity-law radius convention is unclear: the temperature law specifies au, but the velocity expression does not explicitly specify the units of r.
Epoch and array configuration change together for the high-frequency data, so reproducing the beam-smearing check is essential.
Low isotopologue intensity ratios are observational results, not secure measurements of isotope abundances.
